betanything.evidence: identifier: the operator states that BetAnything is the rebranded BetAnySports, whose canonical Odds API key is betanysports. That is the fact this entry rests on, and it is an operator fact rather than something this repository could derive: predictions/api/index.html BOOK_NAMES labels betanysports 'BetAnySports', which is the pre-rebrand name. Destination: predictions/api/go.php declares an explicit betanysports entry, and a request for it answers HTTP 302 to the sportsbook's own betanysports.eu affiliate path rather than to the Bovada fallback.

betonline.evidence: identifier: betonlineag, which predictions/nba-props.html ALL_BOOK_DISPLAY labels 'BetOnline' with affiliate true and which predictions/affiliate_dashboard.json slates carry as the book value in NBA market data. Destination: predictions/api/go.php declares an explicit betonline entry, and a request for it answers HTTP 302 to this book's own affiliate network rather than to the Bovada fallback.

betus.evidence: identifier: predictions/api/index.html BOOK_NAMES maps betus to 'BetUS', and predictions/nba-props.html ALL_BOOK_DISPLAY maps betus to label 'BetUS' with affiliate true. Destination: predictions/api/go.php declares an explicit betus entry, and a request for it answers HTTP 302 to this book's own affiliate network rather than to the Bovada fallback.

bovada.evidence: identifier: predictions/api/index.html BOOK_NAMES maps bovada to 'Bovada', and predictions/nba-props.html ALL_BOOK_DISPLAY maps bovada to label 'Bovada' with affiliate true. Observed in NBA market data: predictions/affiliate_dashboard.json carries 838 rows with book 'bovada'. Destination: predictions/api/go.php declares an explicit bovada entry. A request cannot distinguish that entry from the fallback, because the fallback is Bovada's own destination, so the explicit entry in the source is what verifies this key.

non_affiliate_books_note: Display names only, for books that may appear in the offer universe but earn nothing. Recorded so a fallback selection can be named honestly rather than shown as an opaque key, and recorded separately from the affiliate entries so that nothing here can ever be handed an affiliate destination: no book in this map is routed through the site's redirect and none of them earns a commission. Some of them do have a plain public destination a reader can be sent to, recorded in ops/wizardofodds_fallback_destinations.json, which is a separate file precisely so that a direct link cannot be mistaken for a paid one. This map is a courtesy, not a filter: fallback considers every book in the published offer universe, and a book absent from here is still eligible and is shown under the identifier the data used. Sources: predictions/api/index.html BOOK_NAMES and predictions/nba-props.html ALL_BOOK_DISPLAY, where every one of these carries affiliate: false.
note: The four books automated routing may select for their affiliate value, their canonical Odds API identifier, the tie priority among them and the destination a click is sent to. There is one affiliate tier. A wager no affiliate book offers falls back to the best price among all other books in the published offer universe, which is a price rather than a referral. Identifiers and destinations are recorded only where evidence proves them, and the evidence is quoted per book; nothing here may be filled in from a book's name resembling an identifier.

redirect.evidence: predictions/api/go.php declares exactly four books -- bovada, betonline, betus, betanysports -- and answers each with HTTP 302 to that book's destination. The destinations themselves stay there and are not reproduced here. predictions/api/live_props.php line 1044 states the site's convention: 'Redirect-only links (spec B.7 -- never direct affiliate URL)'.
redirect.unknown_book_behaviour: go.php redirects an unrecognised book to Bovada's destination rather than refusing. A link built from an unproven key would therefore not fail visibly, it would quietly send that book's traffic to Bovada. This is why a destination is recorded only for a key go.php actually declares, and why the router refuses to construct a destination without one.

redirect_note: A click is sent to the site's own redirect rather than to the sportsbook, which is the convention the existing NBA pages follow and which keeps the affiliate-network tracking links in one place on the server instead of copied into this repository. The redirect's key namespace is the site's and is not the Odds API's: BetOnline is betonlineag in the market data and betonline at the redirect, which is why the two are recorded separately. No tracking link, affiliate id, campaign id or click id is recorded here, and none belongs here.
secrets: No credential material is recorded here and none belongs here.
unsupported_books_note: Not supported by the current Odds API integration and therefore not part of automated sportsbook selection. Recorded here so that their absence from routing is a decision on the record rather than an omission, and recorded outside books so that the loader cannot route them: nothing reads this map, and no identifier or destination is declared for any of them. They are not blockers. If one later acquires a canonical Odds API identifier and a declared go.php entry, it becomes a books entry at that point and not before.
